department: Faculty of Medicine and Health Sciences (MH)

deadline.value: No deadline is set; admission can be granted at any point in the academic year.
deadline.quote: There are no deadlines for applying.

also.quote: The deadlines vary depending upon the individual vacancies

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on NTNU's PhD pages.

supervisor.value: You must have reached an agreement with a prospective supervisor when you submit the project plan.
supervisor.quote: The applicant must have made contact and reached an agreement with a prospective supervisor at this point.

funding.value: Most NTNU PhD candidates are paid research fellows, but funding must be documented before admission.
funding.quote: Most PhD candidates at NTNU are employed as PhD research fellows (stipendiat) at NTNU or a university college.

entry_route.value: A master's, cand. med. or equivalent degree from a relevant discipline is needed, with an A or B average.
entry_route.quote: a master, cand. med., or equivalent degree from a relevant discipline

notes: PHMEDHV, the current Medicine and Health Sciences PhD. Also_fields neuro: the programme page says "This includes clinical and molecular medicine, neuroscience, movement science". Replaces the older PHMED programme. No department fee, GRE or English rule.
